items.name: Nvidia Q3 FY27 (Tue 17 Nov after close): revenue USD 115.8bn (+103% y/y) vs ~109.1bn est, Data Center 107.6bn, Q4 guide USD 130bn +/-3% (14 weeks, no China DC compute) vs 125.1bn, GM 71-72%; FY28 growth raised to 75% from 70%; supply commitments USD 390bn, cloud/lease USD 102bn, neocloud commitments USD 32bn conditional on customer funding; 'demand continues to exceed supply' - no digestion/deferral language; board will not return Huang; after-hours +4-5% faded to -0.5% by Asia morning
items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 / Nvidia beats third-quarter estimates as revenue more than doubles / Business as usual for Nvidia as it beats expectations in first earnings call after Huang's resignation
items.claim: SEC 8-K Ex.99.1: Q3 (to 25 Oct) revenue USD 115.8bn, +103% y/y and +20% q/q; Data Center 107.6bn (+110%); non-GAAP EPS 2.68; Q4 outlook 'USD 130.0bn, plus or minus 3%' with 'NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook', GAAP/non-GAAP GM 71.0-72.0%; USD 2.4bn Hopper shipped to China in Q3. Kiplinger live blog (22:20-22:51Z): Kress - 'Commitments to neoclouds total USD 32 billion as of the end of the quarter', effective only if the neocloud 'secures the funding they need' and meets construction/development milestones; 'demand continues to exceed supply'; 'our demand is accelerating, our supply is growing'; FY28 growth framework raised to 75% from 70% ('we feel confident in the demand in front of us, as well as the supply'); Morgan Stanley's Moore questioned the 75%. SiliconANGLE: frontier labs ~15% of DC revenue this year; chairman Harvey Jones - board 'does not intend' to bring Huang back; supply/purchase commitments USD 390bn (from 279bn), cloud-service and DC-lease commitments USD 102bn (from 74bn). After hours: +2.8% at end of prepared remarks, +3.5% ~22:50Z, 'more than 4%' by 23:00Z, 'almost 5%' (Newsquawk 06:10Z); Reuters 04:01Z: 'slid 0.5% in after-hours trading, after earlier rising as much as 3.8%'; CRWV +9%, NBIS +7%. Eiseman: future financing support to prioritise strong customers and projects with land, power and buildings; 10-Q to follow 'in the coming weeks'.
items.candidate_dial: C-capex (principal demand/guidance - no cut, no digestion)
items.source: SEC 8-K Ex.99.1 17 Nov; Kiplinger live blog 17 Nov (UTC timestamps); SiliconANGLE 17 Nov; Proactive via Yahoo 21:41Z; Newsquawk 18 Nov 06:41Z; Reuters via Yahoo 18 Nov 04:01Z; Eiseman ICYMI 18 Nov

Two things the orchestrator may weigh: neocloud commitments are explicitly contingent on the neocloud raising funding, and the after-hours gain was gone by the Asia morning. No transcript was read (CNBC/Converge refused); the Q4 guide is a 14-week quarter.
